title.zh: 将达沃市达沃中央小学的名称变更为村长Tomas Monteverde, Sr.小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Davao Central Elementary School in Davao City to Capitan Tomas Monteverde, Sr. Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Davao Central Elementary School in Davao City to Capitan Tomas Monteverde, Sr. Elementary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1970/ra_6156_1970.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Davao Central Elementary School in Davao City is hereby changed to Capitan Tomas Monteverde, St. Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: November 9, 1970.
